facts.business: De Nora India Limited manufactures and services electrolytic products.

auditor.name: M/s. Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP

key_risks: Enhanced scrutiny on industrial effluent and emissions could indirectly impact service volumes and project schedules if customers cannot meet standards.

Longer duration between service cycles for membrane elements creates revenue concentration risk as recoating operations rely on a small number of high-value projects often deferred or advanced based on customer timelines.
Risk of technological disruption from emerging trends in electrochemical systems, automation, and digital monitoring altering traditional service models.
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought to increase maximum aggregate value of related party transactions with Industrie De Nora S.p.A., Italy from Rs 2,080 Lakhs to Rs 2,430 Lakhs for FY 2026-27.
